import heapq
import collections
input = stdin.readline

    return(int(input()))
def inputnums():
    return(map(int,input().split()))
def inputlist():
    return(list(map(int,input().split())))
def inputstring():
    return([x for x in input()])
def inputstrings():
    return([x for x in input().split()])
